name: Homelite UT10520
blurb: Oregon lists UT10520 with three .325″ .050″ chains: 16″/66, 18″/72 and 20″/78 drive links.
intro: The Homelite UT10520 is not in the low-profile block with the UT10517. Oregon's saw-chain selection guide prints this model in a Homelite block with the UT10518, UT10519, UT10520, UT10522 and other numbers. Under that block it prints three .325″ chains at .050″ gauge: H66 on 16″ (66 drive links), H72 on 18″ (72 drive links) and H78 on 20″ (78 drive links). These are not the 3/8″ low-profile chains in the UT10517 block. Oregon does not assign one length to one model number. The bar on the saw picks the count. The guide does not print a file size.

bars.note: Oregon prints H66 under this Homelite block: 16″ bar, 66 drive links, .050″ gauge, .325″ pitch. No file size is printed.
Oregon prints H72 under this Homelite block: 18″ bar, 72 drive links, .050″ gauge, .325″ pitch. No file size is printed.
Oregon prints H78 under this Homelite block: 20″ bar, 78 drive links, .050″ gauge, .325″ pitch. No file size is printed.

sources.title: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide: model line printed with saw-chain code, bar length, drive links, gauge and pitch

sources_note: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide (https://apps.oregonproducts.com/pdfs/TSC-Chain-Fit-Guide.pdf), read 7 Nov 2026. The guide does not print a file size on these rows.
